tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lce btsun snying tig gi tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir lce btsun snying tig gi klong lnga'i yi ge las dum bu gsum pa'i gnyis pa gsang ba don gyi phrin las spros med tshogs mchod khyad par can bzhugs mod kyang*/ dang po'i las can rnams kyi ched du cung zad spros pa la/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa bsham nas bdag mdun bskyed bzlas gsol ka sogs sngon du 'gro bas skabs su babs pa na/ ru zung bzhi'i bskang bshags sam brjod med don gyi bshags pas rgyud sbyangs te/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/

aḥ ka dag spros bral dbyings kyi tshogs gzhong du/ /'gags med lhun grub snang char thabs shes rdzas/ /gzung 'dzin rang grol 'dod lnga'i longs spyod tshogs/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ a: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nas/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag bcas/ /'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /sarba badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ aḥ myang reg grol ba gsang chen dam tshig rdzas/ /ga ṇa bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dam pa yis/ /lha tshogs thugs dam chos kyi dbyings su bskang*/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog 'od gsal dbyings grol shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā dzñā na ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ aḥ ka dag phyogs yan khyab brdal chen po la/ /ma rig dbang gis gud du gcad pa sogs/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i 'gal khrul nongs pa kun/ /dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags par bgyi/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tha ma la 'gug gzhug byas shing bsgral bstabs ni/ a: bdag 'dzin ru tra'i dug lnga'i phung po khams/ /bdag med ye shes lnga yis mtshon chas bsgral/ /dbyings ye gnyis med rang byung rang snang lha/ /rtsa gsum rab 'byams dkyil 'khor zhal du sbyor/ /ru tra ha la pañtsa pū dza khā hi/ bar 'dir bskang ba rgyas bsdus skabs bstun bya/ thabs shes kyi rdzas las slob kyis btegs te/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ zhes phul/ 'dus pa kun gyis/ rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer du: gdod nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: chos nyid gsal khyab chen po'i ngang : zag med bde ba'i phyag rgyas rol: a la la ho: zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs kyi de kho na nyid kyi don dran bzhin spang blang med par rol/ spro na mar me'i smon lam dang rdo rje'i glu gar bya/ smon lam bzang po'ang gdab/

lhag ma bsdus la zhal chab bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes mkha' lding gi rgyas btegs te/ aḥ sems byung ltar snang lhag sdud tshogs: sems nyid skye med tshogs lhag zhes/ /gzung 'dzin glo bur bar chad dang : 'khrul snang zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ phyi rol du gtsang sar spungs la bzhag: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rol mo bcas dbyangs snyan pos/ a: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /thugs dam gnyan po rjes su dgongs mdzod la/ /'gro rnams yang dag lam la bsgral mdzad gsol/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /'pho chen skur bzhengs bi ma mi tra dang*/ /gdod ma'i mgon po siṃ he shwa ra sogs/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam dus la babs/ /blos byas yid dpyod mun sprul du ma yis/ /'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa gzims nye dus/ /thugs dam ma g.yel rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyis/ /lam bzang ye shes snang ba rgyas par mdzod/ /'bras bu phyi dus yid smon ma yin par/ /lam dang bla mar yid ches dad pa yis/ /bsgrub la brtson 'dod skal bzang bdag cag la/ /mngon sum don gyi dbang mchog bskur thob mdzod/ /sa ma ya ho/ chad tho bsgrags pa ni/ gtor ma gser skyems la bgugs gzhug dang rol mo'i sgras bskul te/ aḥ dbyings las ye shes rang shar ba'i: e ka dza ṭī ral gcig ma: 'od gsal rig pa zang thal sku: khyab 'jug chen po sgra can 'dzin: zung 'jug dwangs ma'i thig le 'dzin: rdo rje dgra 'dul legs pa rtsal: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul bsams yas pa: 'bum phrag dregs pa'i sde tshogs kun: dgongs brda snyan nas brgyud pa yi: rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang : ji snyed 'dus pa'i tshogs chen dang : 'khor 'das zil gnon he ru ka: dpal chen siṃ he shwa ra dang : 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje yis: ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bzhags bzhin:

dur khrod rol pa'i gnas 'dir byon: khams lnga dag pa'i sman phud dang : 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ba liṃ ta: dug lnga bsgral ba'i dmar chen po: dpal gyi pham phab chen por bzhes: theg mchog lam du bzhugs pa la: glo bur bdud bzhi'i bar chad zlog: 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba'i tshe: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sa bon sgrol: rig pa ka dag lta ba la: yid byed mtshan ma'i rtog pa srungs: rig rtsal mngon sum snang ba'i tshe: rlung sems 'gyu ba dbyings su non: mthar thug gzhi dbyings gnyug ma'i klong : gzhi snang rig pa'i phrin las sgrubs: sa ma ya ho: bstan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor ma bshal chu 'bru gsum gyis brlabs/ a ka ro sa bsngos la/ aḥ ka dag dbyings las rig pa'i rtsal/ /sman bdud gnod sbyin mo yi tshul/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma longs/ /las bcol phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs/ /gzhan yang phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma mchod/ /gtor gzhong kha sbub la/ a: rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje'i e klong du/ /'khrul rtog log 'dren 'byung po dam sri kun/ /mnan no ye grol don gyis rgyas btab pas/ /nam yang ldang ba'i skabs med s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ aḥ mngon sum ye shes las byung ba'i: nyams snang gong 'phel pho brang nas: tshad phebs don gyi lha tshogs kyis: blo 'das chos zad dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: bshags pa ni/ a: gzung 'dzin rnam rtog las byung ba'i: las dang nyon mongs sdig sgrib kun: rang bzhin skye med ngang nyid du: 'khor gsum mtshan ma bral bar bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bsdu ldang ni/ aḥ gzhi snang phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor lha: gzhi dbyings gdod ma'i klong du thim: slar yang phyir gsal gzugs kyi sku: dus gsum dus med rtag tu shar: a a a: bsngo ba dang smon lam ni/ lhun gyis grub pa'i dge tshogs kun:

ka dag gzhon nu bum skur bsngo: zung 'jug khyad chos drug ldan gyi: ye shes chen por ro gcig shog: bkra shis ni/ ho: lta ba rang bzhag blo las 'das: chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog: sgom pa mngon sum tshad la phebs: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog: spyod pa dbyings rig 'du 'bral med: sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog: 'bras bu bzhi snang thig le cher: dbyer med chen po'i bkra shis shog: gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ de ltar tshogs mchod kyi rim pa mdor bsdus 'di ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rnams sor bzhag la kha skong dgos rigs gsar du bsnan te/ sngar bris pa la yang bskyar tshig phri bsnan bcas snying po'i bstan 'dzin yongs kyi 'bangs tha dus zhabs kyi sngags ming tsam po pa rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol bas bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// // PAGE PAGE 5 FILENAME S-13.doc
